title: AI Video Dubbing: Translate and dub videos with natural voice and lip sync. | Product Hunt
excerpt: AI Video Dubbing is an online video translation and dubbing tool for creators, educators, marketers, and small teams that want to reach audiences in new languages without recording the video again. Upload a speaker video, select a target language, and generate a translated version that preserves recognizable characteristics of the original voice and synchronizes mouth movements with the new speech. The completed project can include a dubbed MP4 video, translated audio
